segments.name: North America Commercial P&C Insurance
segments.description: Provides property and casualty and accident and health insurance and services to large, middle market, and small commercial businesses in the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda.
segments.evidence: The North America Commercial P&C Insurance segment comprises operations that provide P&C and A&H insurance and services to large, middle market, and small commercial businesses in the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda.

segments.name: North America Personal P&C Insurance
segments.description: Provides personal property and casualty insurance to individuals in North America.
segments.evidence: Chubb operates through six business segments: North America Commercial P&C Insurance, North America Personal P&C Insurance, North America Agricultural Insurance, Overseas General Insurance, Global Reinsurance, and Life Insurance.

segments.name: North America Agricultural Insurance

segments.evidence: Chubb operates through six business segments: North America Commercial P&C Insurance, North America Personal P&C Insurance, North America Agricultural Insurance, Overseas General Insurance, Global Reinsurance, and Life Insurance.

segments.name: Global Reinsurance

segments.name: Life Insurance

revenueModel.text: Chubb earns premiums from insureds, who typically purchase policies through insurance brokers or agents to whom Chubb pays a commission, and also earns investment income on its portfolio.
revenueModel.evidence: For most commercial and personal lines of business we offer, insureds typically use the services of an insurance broker or agent. We obtain business from the local and major international insurance brokers and typically pay a commission to brokers for business accepted and bound.

changes.text: In 2022, Chubb expanded its A&H and life insurance business by acquiring Cigna's business in several Asian markets.
changes.evidence: We expanded our personal accident and supplemental health (A&H), and life insurance business with the acquisition of Cigna's business in several Asian markets in 2022.

changes.text: In 2023, Chubb acquired a controlling majority interest in Huatai Group, a Chinese financial services holding company.
changes.evidence: We further advanced our goal of greater product, customer, and geographical diversification with incremental purchases that led to a controlling majority interest in Huatai Insurance Group Co. Ltd (Huatai Group), a Chinese financial services holding company with separate P&C, life, and asset management subsidiaries (collectively, Huatai) on July 1, 2023.
